ValidationRule.description: As part of DF-01927, this validation rule is updated to allow any user to create Address but only Integration users records can be updated by only integration users.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISNEW() ) , NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) , $Profile.Name != "Integration User" , OR( CreatedBy.Profile.Name = "Integration User" , ISPICKVAL( NSP_Source__c , "AIMS" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Address Created by Integration users can only be updated by Integration users.
